hashesAfterSchemaRename.note: After the experiment, corpus JSON keys were renamed complexityTags->tags and rationale->sourceNote (schema conformance with the Phase 3 corpus spec). No label, text, split, language, or tag-value changed; evaluation results are unaffected.

inference.note: One embedding per semantic turn (query) plus one per prototype at index build: 96 + 224 = 320. Scores cached once; calibration swept 43 candidate thresholds with zero additional inference.

routingConfig.complexMarginNote: Not identifiable from binary tier labels: only renames the TIER_2 reason (SEMANTIC_COMPLEX vs SEMANTIC_AMBIGUOUS), never the tier.

reaudit.reason: Pre-freeze re-audit: macro-F1 NaN for constant predictors; latency benchmark measured the query-embedding cache instead of real inference.
changes: RoutingMetrics: zero-division ratios now use the zero_division=0 convention (0.0 instead of NaN). Constant predictors report macro-F1 0.3333 on balanced classes instead of NaN.

Phase3EvaluationSuite.latencyBenchmark reimplemented: every measured semantic iteration runs real ONNX query tokenization + inference + pooling + normalization + similarity scoring + RoutingDecisionEngine.decide. Asserted 300 real embedding calls (zero cache reuse); prototype embeddings precomputed once in step 1 and reused (asserted zero new prototype inference).
reaudit.note: All result artifacts regenerated by a full real-model suite re-run on 2026-09-28 with the frozen threshold; calibration was NOT re-run and no example was modified.
